title: Brazil FGTS Calculator
description: Estimate monthly FGTS deposits, fine base, and 40% or 20% scenarios with a transparent calculation memory.
metaDescription: Estimate Brazil FGTS monthly deposits, fine base, 40% or 20% fines, and displayed withdrawal using official-source assumptions.

helpers.base: Enter the monthly remuneration/base subject to FGTS. The calculator does not decide which payroll rubrics compose that base.
helpers.months: Use 0 to 600 months to estimate the employment period.
helpers.additional: 13th salary, termination bases, and extra deposits are included only when you enter values.
helpers.balance: If you know the official FGTS balance/base for the contract, enter it to improve the fine base.
helpers.balanceIncludes: Check this if the official balance already includes the deposits estimated here.
helpers.termination: The choice only applies educational multipliers; it does not decide entitlement to a fine or withdrawal.
helpers.withdrawal: Shows common eligible withdrawal scenarios without replacing official CAIXA rules.
helpers.sourceBadge: Source version 2026-06-22: MTE FGTS, FGTS Digital, Law 8.036/1990, and CLT.

depositMemo.title: Deposits
depositMemo.helper: Monthly FGTS is the entered base multiplied by 8%, or by 2% in apprentice mode.

fineMemo.title: Fine and withdrawal
fineMemo.helper: The fine uses the entered official balance/base or, without one, estimated deposits without account correction.

items.domesticoForaDoEscopo: Domestic workers, domestic DAE/eSocial, and the LC 150 monthly 3.2% indemnity contribution are outside this version.
items.semCorrecaoJurosLucro: The estimate does not apply account correction, interest, TR/IPCA, JAM, FGTS profit distribution, or late-payment charges.
items.fontesOficiaisPrevalecem: FGTS Digital, eSocial, CAIXA, TRCT, employer declarations, and professional review prevail over this simulation.
items.baseEstimadaSemCorrecao: Without an official balance, the fine base uses estimated deposits and does not reproduce official account history.
items.saldoAusente: A fine scenario was selected without an official balance/base; check the extract or FGTS Digital.
items.aprendizRevisaoRescisao: Apprenticeship contracts use 2% monthly deposits, but termination and fines depend on contract and official records review.
items.rescisaoIndiretaReconhecimento: Indirect termination must be officially, judicially, or validly recognized before confirming rights.
items.culpaReciprocaForcaMaiorReconhecimento: Mutual fault or force majeure requires specific recognition; withdrawal is not displayed in this first version.

method.title: Short calculation memory.
method.text: The calculator multiplies entered bases by the deposit rate, sums estimated deposits, and applies 40%, 20%, or 0% according to the selected scenario.
method.sourceNote: Sources accessed on {accessDate}; MTE FGTS page updated on {mteUpdate} and FGTS Digital termination-base guidance on {digitalUpdate}.
method.disclaimer: Educational estimate only, not legal, labor, accounting, or official payroll advice. FGTS Digital/eSocial/CAIXA, official extracts, and professional review prevail.

monthly.title: How to calculate monthly FGTS
monthly.p1: The monthly estimate uses the FGTS base you typed and applies the standard 8% rate. In apprentice mode, it applies 2%.
monthly.p2: The tool does not classify payroll rubrics. Enter the base you want to test from a payslip, payroll record, or professional guidance.

additionalBases.title: FGTS on 13th salary and termination bases
additionalBases.p1: 13th salary may generate an additional deposit when you enter its corresponding base.
additionalBases.p2: Termination amounts enter only as user-entered base; the calculator does not decide notice pay, averages, additions, or rubric incidence.

fine.title: How to estimate the 40% or 20% FGTS fine
fine.p1: Dismissal without cause and recognized indirect termination use 40% over the entered or estimated base. CLT art. 484-A agreement and mutual fault/force majeure use 20%.
fine.p2: Resignation, dismissal for cause, and no-termination simulations show zero fine in this version.

officialBalance.title: When to enter the official FGTS balance
officialBalance.text: Enter the official balance or base when you have an extract, FGTS Digital value, or termination base. Without it, the calculator uses estimated deposits without correction, interest, or profit.

exclusions.title: What this calculator does not do
exclusions.p1: It does not calculate domestic-worker DAE/eSocial, late FGTS, correction, interest, TR/IPCA, JAM, profit distribution, anniversary withdrawal, financing, or FGTS-backed loans.
exclusions.p2: It also does not generate guides, send eSocial events, or replace CAIXA, FGTS Digital, TRCT, official payroll, or professional review.

disclaimer.text: This calculator is an educational FGTS estimate, not legal, labor, accounting, operational, or official payroll advice. FGTS Digital, eSocial, CAIXA, TRCT, employer records, and professional review prevail.

q1.question: What is the monthly FGTS rate?
q1.answer: For the standard calculation in this version, the rate is 8% of the entered base. For apprenticeship contracts, the advanced option uses 2%.

q2.question: Does FGTS apply to 13th salary?
q2.answer: There may be a deposit over the 13th salary base. The calculator applies the rate only to the amount you enter in that field.

q3.question: How do I calculate the 40% FGTS fine?
q3.answer: Choose dismissal without cause or recognized indirect termination. The calculator multiplies the fine base by 40%.

q4.question: Does mutual agreement termination have a 20% fine?
q4.answer: In the CLT art. 484-A agreement scenario, this version applies a 20% fine and shows an educational withdrawal up to 80% of the base.

q5.question: Can I calculate domestic-worker FGTS here?
q5.answer: No. Domestic workers, domestic DAE/eSocial, and the monthly 3.2% indemnity contribution require their own flow outside this version.

q6.question: Does the calculator correct the balance with interest, TR/IPCA, or profit?
q6.answer: No. It does not apply correction, interest, JAM, IPCA, TR, FGTS profit distribution, or late-payment charges.

q7.question: Does this replace FGTS Digital?
q7.answer: No. It is educational; FGTS Digital, eSocial, CAIXA, official extracts, TRCT, and professional review prevail.
